title: common/revision-set
description: Revision pins for a contract object. schema_version is required on every contract object; named slots pin the producing artifacts (commit SHAs, release tags, or integer revisions). A consumer with max known schema_version N rejects any execution-bearing object declaring > N (CONTRACTS.md §5.3).

schema_version.description: Non-negative integer schema version; required on every contract object.

revision.description: A pinned revision: a non-empty string (tag, SHA, SemVer) or a non-negative integer.
